import BusyBeaver.ZFC.NativeTheory254

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.NativeTheory254
open Form ProfileCollection NativeDecoded254

#print axioms sentences_NativeAx
#print axioms sat_irForm
#print axioms models_NativeAx
#print axioms decoded_of_native
#print axioms native_of_encodable
#print axioms c254_refutation_iff
#print axioms program_halts_iff_native_refutation
#print axioms native_consistency_iff_program_nonhalting

-- The actual theory includes native equality matrices as closed axioms.
example : BProv NativeAx [] (sealF (ProfileSyntax.gicForm (.fEq 1 2))) :=
  BProv_ax (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨.fEq 1 2, rfl⟩))

-- A supplied nonempty model directly excludes actual structured-program halting.
example (D : Type) (mem : D → D → Prop) (v : Nat → D)
    (h : ∀ f, NativeAx f → Sat mem v f) :
    ¬ RMDag.IterHalts Dag254.dag254 (RMDag.upd (fun _ => 0) 0 2) := by
  intro hh
  exact soundness_BProv (program_halts_iff_native_refutation.mp hh) v h
    (fun _ hNil => by cases hNil)

-- The exact raw theory refutation yields numerical falsity and its actual DAG halt.
example (h : BProv NativeAx [] fBot) :
    Code254.C254 Code254.F ∧
      RMDag.IterHalts Dag254.dag254 (RMDag.upd (fun _ => 0) 0 2) :=
  ⟨c254_refutation_iff.mpr h, program_halts_iff_native_refutation.mpr h⟩

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.NativeTheory254
theory_axioms: sealF (ProfileSyntax.gicForm phi) for every native actual Form phi
open_matrix_parameters: Universally closed by sealF; models_NativeAx extracts every valuation.
model_nonempty: Completeness and soundness receive explicit Nat→D valuation; no no-model premise over empty domains.

directions.numeric_to_native: First-order sentence-theory completeness; every native model is a decoded numerical soundness model.
directions.native_to_numeric: Numeric completeness; every nonempty EncBundle model is a native theory model, then BProv soundness excludes native Bottom.

program_semantics: RMDag.IterHalts Dag254.dag254 (upd zero 0 2), using proved L2.program_halts_iff.
independent_review: Fibers read entire source and note: sealed actual fullForm GIC, explicit valuations in both completeness directions, polarity, universe scope, unrestricted existing matrix adapter and actual219-DAG endpoint clean; no additional set axioms or binary claim.
